programs.title: Jason's Table: Masterful Dishes
programs.desc: Food carving elevates delicacies to visual delights. From dragon made of carrot, taro and shrimps, to phoenix made of bottarga, Taiwanese Chef Liao Ching-chih morphs ingredients into flavorful spectacles.

programs.title: Murder Below Deck
programs.desc: When Lauren gives up the corporate life and a cheating boyfriend, she joins her best friend working aboard a yacht in the South Pacific. As her first voyage sets sail, she falls for entrepreneur Mark.

programs.title: Couples Retreat Murder
programs.desc: Trying to save their marriage, Becky and Jim head to a couple's retreat which just so happens to include Becky's ex. Things only get worse when one of the guests goes missing and their host is found dead.

programs.title: Enlighten Your Life
programs.desc: Even within a family, everyone needs their own space, and the homes you'll see today capture the essence of 'Together, Yet Apart'. Let's explore an open house in Bundang and a forest-view home in Yongin.

programs.title: Theresa Caputo: Raising Spirits
programs.sub_title: Beyond The Readings: We Get The Belt Now
programs.desc: Beyond just accumulating frequent flier miles, Theresa's journey has been one of personal growth and transformation. She offers viewers a rare glimpse behind-the-scenes from her travels.

programs.title: The Mother Flip
programs.desc: Rebecca and Kristy get a hot tip about a former rental property on the outskirts of Austin. Within city limits and close to the airport, the ranch-style home definitely has a country feel.

programs.title: Masterchef Australia
programs.desc: Tonight's challenge is to tame some of the world's most extreme ingredients. The bottom dish will send its maker home.

programs.title: Oceanfront Property Hunt
programs.desc: Tania and Sundara moved to the East Coast for work and are now looking to find a permanent place to live and expand their family. They want a peaceful place near the ocean to relax and enjoy each other.

programs.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
programs.desc: Rachael is known for her delicious and flavourful pesto sauces of all varieties. She prepares a pesto alla trapanese, a Sicilian dish made with almonds and tomatoes.

programs.title: Jason's Table: Masterful Dishes
programs.desc: Follow Jason Wang and learn about the White Snow Osmanthus Crab, a classic Taiwanese dish that marries theatricality with oceanic umami. Master Chef Kuo Hong-che demonstrates how it is made.

programs.title: Jason's Table: Masterful Dishes
programs.desc: Join Jason Wang to explore the Pagoda of Once Cut Pork, a renowned Taiwanese dish where Chef Hong Ming skillfully carves pork belly into a delectable, melt-in-your-mouth “pagoda” with precision knife work.

programs.title: Jake Makes It Easy
programs.sub_title: Schnitzel Sandwich Celery Root Remoulade & Chocolate Chip Cookie Brittle
programs.desc: Taking inspiration from one of his husband's favourite dishes as a child, Jake makes celery-root remoulade and adds a European twist to the fried chicken sandwich.
